title: Vonage SMS for Casdoor Verification Codes
headline: Send verification codes with Vonage
summary: Use your Vonage account to text the verification codes Casdoor sends when users sign up, sign in with a code, reset a password or use SMS as a second factor. Casdoor sends each message through the Vonage SMS API and reports Vonage's error if a message is refused.

steps.title: Get the API key and secret
steps.text: Sign in to the Vonage API Dashboard and copy the **API key** and **API secret** shown at the top of the dashboard.

steps.title: Install Vonage from the Marketplace
steps.text: On the **Marketplace** page of Casdoor, install Vonage and enter the API key as the client ID and the API secret as the client secret. Casdoor adds an SMS provider of type **Plugin** with the same name.

steps.title: Set the sender and the text
steps.text: On the provider's page, set **Sign Name** to the sender: a number you rent from Vonage, or an alphanumeric sender ID of up to 11 letters and digits where the destination country allows one. **Template code** is the text of the message, with `%s` where the code goes; left empty, it is the default below.

steps.title: Send a test message
steps.text: Enter your own phone number next to **SMS Test** on the provider's page and send a test message, then add the provider to an application's **Providers** with the rules you need, such as sign-up, sign-in or MFA.

tips: A trial Vonage account can only send to the test numbers you have added in the dashboard; add credit to send to any number.

Some countries, such as the United States and Canada, do not accept alphanumeric sender IDs, and some need the sender or the template registered first. Check Vonage's country-specific features before sending there.
A text with characters outside the GSM alphabet, such as Chinese or emoji, is sent as unicode, which fits fewer characters into one message.

faqs.question: Does Casdoor run code from the Marketplace for this?
faqs.answer: Yes, a small WebAssembly module that runs inside Casdoor in a sandbox. It cannot read files or the database, and can only send requests to `rest.nexmo.com`.

faqs.question: Does it use Vonage Verify?
faqs.answer: No. Casdoor creates and checks the code itself and only uses Vonage to deliver the text, so the code works the same way as with Casdoor's other SMS providers.
